# Wisdom Raises $21M in Series A Funding

-

August 21, 2025

Wisdom, a San Francisco, CA-based a provider of an AI-powered dental RCM platform, raised $21M in Series A funding.

The round was led by Permanent Capital Ventures (PCV) with participation from Aquiline.

Juxtapose followed their recent $7M Seed investment, reaffirming the firm’s commitment to Wisdom’s continued growth.

The company intends to use the funds to further enhance its technology platform, accelerate market expansion, and continue building out its exceptional team to better serve dental offices of all sizes, from private practices to multi-location dental groups across the country.

Led by CEO Stoyan Kenderov, Wisdom is a billing company that allows dental practices to outsource their insurance collections, insurance verification and patient billing processes. It leverages a combination of AI technology, proprietary data, and highly trained billing professionals to deliver the most efficient and effective billing service possible, empowering practices by taking away the pain of dealing with insurances and providing professional revenue management so that dental teams can focus on delivering awesome dentistry.

The raise brought the amount to $28M since its founding in 2023.

# Wisdom Raises $21 Million in Series A

Wisdom, a New York-based AI-powered dental revenue cycle management (RCM) platform, has raised $21 million in Series A funding, bringing its total capital raised to $28 million.

 by Ben Murray 

 Updated August 22, 2025 

Wisdom, a New York-based AI-powered dental revenue cycle management (RCM) platform, has raised $21 million in Series A funding, bringing its total capital raised to $28 million. 

## Investors

The round was led by Permanent Capital Ventures (PCV), with participation from Aquiline and existing investor Juxtapose. 

Permanent Capital Ventures is an expansion-stage venture capital firm that partners with exceptional founders building AI application businesses. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, the firm invests in software and marketplace businesses after they have achieved product-market fit. 

## Wisdom Use of Funds

The company will use the funds to enhance its AI-driven RCM technology, expand its market reach, and grow its team to serve more dental practices nationwide. 

## About Wisdom

Led by CEO Stoyan Kenderov, Wisdom is an AI-powered dental revenue cycle management platform. The company combines advanced AI agents with U.S.-based billing experts to optimize collections, reduce administrative costs, and improve patient satisfaction. Founded in 2023, Wisdom’s services are designed to help dental practices increase revenue and streamline operations. Headquartered in New York, Wisdom’s mission is to transform dental billing and revenue management. 

## Funding Details

Company: Wisdom 

Raised: $21.0M 

Round: Series A 

Funding Date: August 2025 

Lead Investor: Permanent Capital Ventures (PCV) 

Additional Investors: Aquiline, Juxtapose 

Company Website: https://www.withwisdom.com/
